response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth across multiple domains and has relevant developer tools experience, this is a full-time people-leadership role requiring a minimum of 2 years in people management or team leadership. The candidate has no explicit management experience, having consistently held individual contributor positions (Senior Software Developer, Staff Software Engineer) throughout his 15+ year career. Missing the core people management requirement is a critical blocker for a mid-to-senior management position.
strengths: Exceptional technical depth with 15+ years of software development experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Relevant developer tools and testing infrastructure experience through open-source projects (Fluent-Asserts, Trial, GISCollective) and current AI-agent infrastructure work at re:cinq
Demonstrated commitment to knowledge sharing and mentoring through workshops, refactoring dojos, courses, and technical speaking engagements
concerns: No people management or team leadership experience, which is a mandatory minimum requirement for this role
Career progression shows consistent advancement as an individual contributor with no transition into management roles or people-leading positions
No demonstrated experience with team performance management, organizational change, or strategic roadmap planning for teams

key_factors.factor: Strong technical expertise and developer tools background
